gates.label: Operation loses money at the forecast production rate
gates.basis: CRIRSCO: material that is not economically mineable cannot be reported as a Mineral Reserve. A negative cash margin is a feasibility failure, not a low score.
gates.threshold_status: PROTOTYPE_THRESHOLD (-5% allows for near-break-even strategic tonnes)

gates.label: Forecast production sits below the break-even volume
gates.basis: Break-even volume is the standard mine-economics feasibility test.
gates.threshold_status: DERIVED (0% is the definitional break-even point)

gates.label: Geological confidence too low to support a mining decision
gates.basis: CRIRSCO International Reporting Template: there is no direct link from an Inferred Mineral Resource to any category of Mineral Reserve, and Inferred material must not be used for detailed planning.

gates.label: Required fleet cannot be assembled from available plus standby units
gates.basis: Truck-shovel fleet-sizing practice: a fleet gap beyond redeployable standby capacity is a capital decision, not an operating adjustment.

gates.label: Unacceptably high probability of missing the production target
gates.basis: Supply-reliability constraint: MOIL's stated business problem is continuity of ore supply to customers, so a high-probability material shortfall is a feasibility failure against the platform objective.

gates.label: Model and data confidence below the decision floor
gates.basis: Uncertainty-aware decision principle in the platform specification: the system must distinguish model confidence from geological certainty and must not convert low-information evidence into a final verdict.

gates.label: Reserve too small to justify a standalone block development
gates.basis: Minimum scale for a discrete block decision; below this the tonnes are better treated as an extension of an adjacent block than as a separate decision.
gates.threshold_status: PROTOTYPE_THRESHOLD (120 kt) - calibrate with MOIL block history

gates.label: Wet-season ground conditions prevent reliable haulage
gates.basis: Field studies of rainfall effects on open-pit haulage record cycle-time increases of up to ~15.6% and truck productivity losses up to ~13.1% in wet conditions; beyond that, haulage becomes intermittent rather than slow.

provenance: MOIL corporate disclosure: ten mines across Nagpur and Bhandara districts (Maharashtra) and Balaghat district (Madhya Pradesh); seven underground, three opencast.
Company production and realisation used for calibration
MOIL Annual Report FY2024-25: 18.03 lakh tonnes produced, 15.87 lakh tonnes sold, average realisation Rs 9,164 per tonne, reserves and resources 121.97 Mt at 31 March 2025.
MOIL product disclosure and IBM Indian Minerals Yearbook user specifications: ferro-manganese 44-48% Mn, medium 34-44%, blast-furnace 25-34%, dioxide 48-62%.
Secondary climatology; Bhandara interpolated. Replace with IMD district normals in production.
NASA SMAP L3 9 km soil moisture at 2-3 day revisit, ESA Copernicus Sentinel-2 at 10 m and 5-day revisit, USGS Landsat 8/9 thermal, ECMWF ERA5-Land, SRTM and Copernicus DEM.
Peer-reviewed open-pit shovel-truck benchmark study: availability 77-78%, utilisation 61-65%, OEE 41-44%.
Anchored on a peer-reviewed field study: cycle time up 15.6% at most, excavator productivity down 16.5% at most, truck productivity down 13.1% at most under wet conditions.
CRIRSCO International Reporting Template: Measured, Indicated and Inferred, with no direct link from an Inferred resource to any reserve category.
Approximate placements around published mine localities plus a random offset. Not survey positions.
Block geology: tonnage, grade, thickness, depth, sampling density
Public data was insufficient for these fields; values are generated from industry-informed assumptions inside the real grade bands.
Block equipment fleet, availability, downtime, cycle times
MOIL publishes no block-level fleet or telemetry data. Generated inside the peer-reviewed benchmark envelope.
Block cost structure and price realisation
MOIL publishes no block-level cost. The price ladder is calibrated so the tonnage-weighted portfolio realisation reproduces the real published FY25 average.
Blasting frequency, delays, production and shortfall
No public blasting, dispatch or production log exists at block level. Generated by explicit physical simulation.
Verdict bands and most hard-constraint thresholds
Prototype thresholds requiring calibration with MOIL historical block outcomes before real use.
